description:
Found by fz-kdt.69.2: the stores are lowering's authority and are never
pruned when their ledger fact retracts; the ledger-withdrawn/store-stale
state is read nowhere today (measured 0 across corpus/lib/matrix/cli) but
three artifact.rs unit tests construct exactly that state, so the invariant
is accidental, not structural. fz-kdt.69.3 makes the ledger authoritative
over live demand -- align the stores there (prune on retraction, or document
the store-outlives-ledger contract explicitly and gate reads).
title: CallSiteMap/CallSiteTargetsMap slots never pruned on fact retraction
